format.description: The version of this format. A reader skips a template whose format is newer than it knows.

id.description: Lowercase words joined by hyphens, unique, and the same for good: lists remember their template by it.

name.description: What the picker calls it, and a new list’s name until someone changes it.

description.description: One line for the picker: what this kind of list is for and what it does.

icon.description: A Material Symbols icon, by its name in lowercase with hyphens: "shopping-cart".

color.description: One of seven tones; each app draws its own shade of it.

placeholder.description: What the add field says while it is empty.

sections.description: How items are sorted under headings. Left out, a list is one plain run of items.

options.description: The sections a new list starts with, in order. Each list can change its own.

free.description: People name sections as they add, like who a gift is for.

none.description: The heading for items in no section. "Other" when left out.

days.description: The options are the weekdays Monday to Sunday, shown from today on, like a meal plan.

store.description: Which store, to filter by on the way round.

parts.description: A list of parts, like a meal’s ingredients.

fields.description: Extra fields each item can have. Every item has a name and a note.

checked.description: What checked items are called, where they wait to be added again: "Recently got", "Packed".

actions.description: What the list itself can do, beyond adding and checking off.

trip.description: The whole list plans as one task on a day, like a grocery run.

title.description: The task’s title: "Grocery run". A list with a name of its own uses that instead: "Costco run".

minutes.description: How long the trip takes, for planning the day around it.

reset.description: "Start over" unchecks everything, for a list used again and again.

sendParts.description: The id of a template: each item’s parts go to the household’s list of that kind in one tap, like a meal’s ingredients to Groceries.

private.description: A new list of this kind starts out seen only by the person who made it, like gift ideas.

kits.description: Ready-made items a new list can start with. The first is picked unless someone picks another or none.

name.description: What the kit is called in the picker: "Camping".

section.description: Which of the sections it goes in.

quantity.description: How many or how much, as people write it: "2", "1 lb".

hint.description: A line for an AI that sorts what people type into lists: how this kind of list is used.

title: List template
description: A kind of list, with its sections, item fields, actions and starter kits. See templates/README.md in the Amble repository.
